label: Cross-tweak
detail: Lift from the centre holes: all four tyres should leave the board together. Needing more than 1.0 mm preload difference means a real fault, not a tweak.

label: Ride height measured right
detail: Measure behind the front arm and in front of the rear arm, never at the worn chassis ends.

label: Belts quiet, rear not tighter
detail: No clack or skip under hard throttle or braking; the rear belt must not be tighter than the front (rear overdrive makes it loose on power).

label: Tyres glued
detail: Check the beads; re-glue every 3-4 runs.

label: Steering free at full lock
detail: At full lock the linkage moves by hand and the servo does not buzz (EPA not binding).

label: Battery holder not over-tight
detail: The pack should float slightly; a clamped pack locks out chassis flex.

label: Anti-roll bars free
detail: Bars sit flat and move freely with slight play; over-tight collars bind them.

label: Body lip and stoppers
detail: Front lip 7-8 mm on asphalt; stoppers touch only at the end of travel, not holding the body up.

label: Drivetrain spins free
detail: With the pinion out of mesh the drivetrain spins freely; spur mesh has a little backlash.

label: Tyres rotated
detail: Swap left/right after every pack so wear stays even.

label: Left/right weight
detail: Aim for 50/50; 51/49 is acceptable. On the BD12 the electronics sit left and the battery right.

label: Steering equal both ways
detail: Turnbuckles equal length; the physical throw matches left and right (EPA numbers may differ).

label: Droop re-set after ride height
detail: Ride height (and tyre wear) changes droop; re-set the downstops after any ride-height change.

label: Track state
detail: Cold, dusty morning track? Grip usually climbs through the day; compare runs with that in mind.
